data.one_liner: A custom tab viewer widget with built-in switching animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides an animated toggle tab widget allowing users to switch between multiple tabs with customized styling, decorations, and animations. It includes options for active/inactive text styles, callback controls, and initial index configuration.
use_when: You need a custom animated tab switcher instead of the default TabBar
You want to customize tab decorations and active/inactive states easily
avoid_when: You require a full complex tab navigation architecture with offscreen page retaining by default
You need advanced material or cupertino design system tabs
strengths: Highly customizable decorations and text styles for active and inactive states
weaknesses: Limited to basic text-labeled tabs based on the provided parameters
Not documented for complex nested navigation views
data.minimal_example:
AppinioAnimatedToggleTab(
  callback: (int i) {},
  tabTexts: const [
    'make',
    'your',
    'tabs :)',
  ],
  height: 40,
  width: 300,
  boxDecoration: BoxDecoration(color: Color(0xFFc3d2db)),
  animatedBoxDecoration: BoxDecoration(
    color: Colors.blue,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(5)),
  ),
  activeStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.blue),
  inactiveStyle: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black),
)
